ca_gov_primary_akinyemi_agbede.stance: Dr. Agbede plans to expand access to affordable housing while enhancing support services for homeless individuals.
ca_gov_primary_akinyemi_agbede.quote: Expanding access to affordable housing while enhancing support services for homeless individuals, ensuring stable living conditions and long-term solutions.

ca_gov_primary_akinyemi_agbede.stance: Dr. Agbede plans to create job opportunities, support businesses, and implement tax reforms to reduce the financial burden on families.
ca_gov_primary_akinyemi_agbede.quote: Creating job opportunities, supporting businesses, and implementing tax reforms to reduce the financial burden on families and foster economic prosperity.

ca_gov_primary_akinyemi_agbede.stance: Dr. Agbede plans to strengthen community policing and invest in crime prevention programs.
ca_gov_primary_akinyemi_agbede.quote: Strengthening community policing efforts and investing in crime prevention programs to enhance security, build trust, and create safer neighborhoods.

ca_gov_primary_xavier_becerra.stance: He says that as Governor he will ensure California continues to lead on protecting access to abortion.
ca_gov_primary_xavier_becerra.quote: As Governor, I will ensure that California continues to lead when it comes to protecting access to abortion, to the ballot, and to live and love without restraint.

ca_gov_primary_xavier_becerra.stance: He states that in 1996 he was among a small group of members of Congress who voted against the Defense of Marriage Act.
ca_gov_primary_xavier_becerra.quote: In 1996, I was among a small group of members of Congress to vote against the Defense of Marriage Act.

ca_gov_primary_xavier_becerra.stance: On his first day he would issue an executive order directing state agencies to maintain coverage continuity for Californians affected by federal cuts or Medi-Cal rollbacks.
ca_gov_primary_xavier_becerra.quote: On Day One, I will issue an executive order directing state agencies to maintain coverage continuity for every Californian affected by federal cuts or Medi-Cal rollbacks.

ca_gov_primary_xavier_becerra.stance: He says he will fight to fully implement Proposition 35, which dedicates MCO tax revenue exclusively to Medi-Cal.
ca_gov_primary_xavier_becerra.quote: And I will fight to fully implement Proposition 35, which California voters passed in November 2024 to dedicate MCO tax revenue exclusively to Medi-Cal, ensuring those funds go to stronger provider payments and expanded access to care, not federal clawbacks.

ca_gov_primary_xavier_becerra.stance: He plans to establish a long-term dedicated fund to grow the healthcare workforce, including loan repayment, housing assistance, and targeted provider incentives.
ca_gov_primary_xavier_becerra.quote: I will establish a long-term dedicated fund to grow the healthcare workforce where it is needed most, offering loan repayment and forgiveness programs, housing assistance in high-cost areas, and targeted incentives for primary care, behavioral health, women’s care, rural medicine, and dental providers.

ca_gov_primary_xavier_becerra.stance: He says he will pursue a fee on large employers who do not offer health coverage to low-wage workers who qualify for Medi-Cal.
ca_gov_primary_xavier_becerra.quote: I will pursue a fee on large employers who do not offer health coverage to their low-wage workers who qualify for Medi-Cal, so that corporations who shift their healthcare costs onto taxpayers pay their fair share.

ca_gov_primary_xavier_becerra.stance: He claims that as HHS Secretary he negotiated drug price reductions of up to 79% on widely used medications, the first direct federal bargaining with pharmaceutical companies on behalf of patients.
ca_gov_primary_xavier_becerra.quote: As HHS Secretary, I negotiated drug price reductions of up to 79% on some of the most widely used medications in America, the first time the federal government had ever directly bargained with pharmaceutical companies on behalf of patients.

ca_gov_primary_xavier_becerra.stance: On his first day he would declare California’s housing shortage a state of emergency and make housing production and affordability the paramount priority for every state agency.
ca_gov_primary_xavier_becerra.quote: On my first day as Governor, I will issue an executive order declaring California’s housing shortage a state of emergency and directing every state agency to treat housing production and affordability as the paramount priority.

ca_gov_primary_xavier_becerra.stance: He plans to develop the state's first California Housing Affordability Master Plan, with a target that median-income families can afford median-priced homes.
ca_gov_primary_xavier_becerra.quote: My administration will develop the first-ever California Housing Affordability Master Plan, setting a target of median-income families being able to afford median-priced homes, and unifying the state’s response across zoning, streamlining, fees, financing, and regulatory costs.

ca_gov_primary_xavier_becerra.stance: He says bill affordability will be central to his energy policy, especially for low- and middle-income families.
ca_gov_primary_xavier_becerra.quote: Bill affordability will be at the center of my energy policy, especially for low- and middle-income families.

ca_gov_primary_xavier_becerra.stance: He pledges to fully enforce California’s Tenant Protection Act, including its rent increase cap, just cause eviction standards, and relocation assistance.
ca_gov_primary_xavier_becerra.quote: I will fully enforce California’s Tenant Protection Act, including its cap on excessive rent increases, just cause eviction standards, and relocation assistance for displaced tenants, as a critical front-line tool to prevent homelessness before it starts.

ca_gov_primary_derek_grasty.stance: Says he will keep ICE off California's streets.
ca_gov_primary_derek_grasty.quote: Together, we will keep kidnappers (ICE) off our streets, make housing affordable for working families, first responders, teachers, firefighters, and nurses.

ca_gov_primary_derek_grasty.stance: Says everyone should have affordable housing, a safe community, and a quality education.
ca_gov_primary_derek_grasty.quote: That means affordable housing, a safe community and a quality education.

ca_gov_primary_derek_grasty.stance: Says education will be supported with pre-school, reading specialists, and mental health counselors.
ca_gov_primary_derek_grasty.quote: Education will be supported with pre-school, reading specialists, and mental health counselors to help our students thrive.

ca_gov_primary_gary_howard_kidgell.stance: Opposes a wealth tax as a way to address California's challenges.
ca_gov_primary_gary_howard_kidgell.quote: California is facing real challenges, and we need real solutions — but a wealth tax is not the way to go.

ca_gov_primary_gary_howard_kidgell.stance: Favors managing the budget wisely and monitoring spending carefully instead of creating new, uncertain tax structures.
ca_gov_primary_gary_howard_kidgell.quote: Instead of creating new and uncertain tax structures, we should focus on managing our budget wisely, monitoring spending carefully, and ensuring every dollar is used effectively.

ca_gov_primary_gary_howard_kidgell.stance: Supports strengthening public–private partnerships and encouraging civic investment to rebuild the state.
ca_gov_primary_gary_howard_kidgell.quote: By strengthening public–private partnerships and encouraging civic investment, we can rebuild our state without relying on policies that risk driving away innovation, jobs, and opportunity.

ca_gov_primary_gary_howard_kidgell.stance: Plans a mandatory pass-through of wholesale cost drops to lower grocery bills.
ca_gov_primary_gary_howard_kidgell.quote: Mandatory pass‑through of wholesale cost drops

ca_gov_primary_gary_howard_kidgell.stance: Plans to convert vacant commercial buildings as part of housing affordability.

ca_gov_primary_matthew_chase_levy.stance: His venture firm, AE Blue Capital, backs fusion and other advanced clean-energy technologies that the text says address California's energy costs, grid reliability, and decarbonization goals.
ca_gov_primary_matthew_chase_levy.quote: He is the founder of NobleAI, a Science-Based AI platform that accelerates discovery and innovation in chemistry, materials, and energy sectors, and AE Blue Capital, a venture firm that backs fusion and other advanced clean-energy technologies critical to addressing California’s rising energy costs, grid reliability issues, and long-term decarbonization goals.

ca_gov_primary_matt_mahan.stance: He says he won't ask Californians to pay more in taxes without results.
ca_gov_primary_matt_mahan.quote: Matt won’t ask Californians to pay more in taxes without results.

ca_gov_primary_matt_mahan.stance: He will work to drive down the cost of living, build more affordable housing, make cities safe, and ensure all kids have an opportunity to succeed.
ca_gov_primary_matt_mahan.quote: He will work to drive down the cost of living, build more affordable housing, make our cities safe, and ensure all kids have an opportunity to succeed.

ca_gov_primary_matt_mahan.stance: He says he is getting people off the streets and into treatment and housing, and that he reduced San Jose's homeless population by a third.
ca_gov_primary_matt_mahan.quote: Matt Mahan reduced San Jose's homeless population by a third. He’s getting people off the streets, into treatment, and into housing.

ca_gov_primary_matt_mahan.stance: He says he has broken ground on thousands of new housing units and retrofitted old buildings to help people off the streets.
ca_gov_primary_matt_mahan.quote: He has broken ground on thousands of new housing units and retrofitted old buildings to get people off the streets and back on their feet.

ca_gov_primary_matt_mahan.stance: He supports California Proposition 36, as stated in his 2024 op-ed headline.
ca_gov_primary_matt_mahan.quote: I'm a Democratic mayor. Here's the reason I support California's Prop. 36

ca_gov_primary_matt_mahan.stance: He pledged to end automatic raises for politicians and city department heads unless progress is shown.
ca_gov_primary_matt_mahan.quote: He pledged to end automatic raises for politicians and city department heads unless progress is shown.

ca_gov_primary_matt_mahan.stance: He proposed an accountability dashboard to track progress on issues like crime and homelessness.
ca_gov_primary_matt_mahan.quote: He proposed an accountability dashboard which would track progress on issues like crime and homelessness.

ca_gov_primary_katie_porter.stance: Her plan would speed up housing construction by nearly two years and reduce apartment housing costs by 20%.
ca_gov_primary_katie_porter.quote: Time is money in housing, and I have a plan to speed up building by nearly two years, putting California on par with its peer states that also have worker and environmental protections. This will bring down the costs of apartment housing by 20%.

ca_gov_primary_katie_porter.stance: She would fight federal Medi-Cal and health care cuts and strengthen the state's health care system and workforce.
ca_gov_primary_katie_porter.quote: As your Governor, I will fight these cuts with every fiber of my being and work to fortify our health care system at the state level so we can protect, expand and improve health care for all of our residents, while making sure our health care workforce has the support they need to care for Californians.

ca_gov_primary_katie_porter.stance: She would use homelessness prevention through emergency rental assistance and rapid re-housing, plus interim housing, strategies she says California has not adopted.
ca_gov_primary_katie_porter.quote: My homelessness plan focuses on two strategies that California has not adopted: homeless prevention through emergency rental assistance and rapid re-housing, and interim housing that can keep people from being unsheltered, which is itself a risk factor for mental health and substance use problems.

ca_gov_primary_katie_porter.stance: She supports paying child care providers more to build a stronger child care workforce.
ca_gov_primary_katie_porter.quote: The best way to expand access to care is by ensuring we have a robust workforce. This means paying providers more.

ca_gov_primary_katie_porter.stance: She aims to make California the first state to reach 100% clean energy output, 365 days a year, and invest in renewables and grid expansion.
ca_gov_primary_katie_porter.quote: Under my governorship, California will be positioned to become the first state to achieve 100% clean energy output, 365 days a year—which will drive down costs and make energy more affordable for Californians.

ca_gov_primary_katie_porter.stance: She believes every worker deserves a union and supports policies to create and enforce that right.
ca_gov_primary_katie_porter.quote: Every worker deserves a union. We must create – and enforce – policies that deliver that opportunity.

ca_gov_primary_katie_porter.stance: In Congress she championed bills protecting LGBTQ+ students from bullying and harassment and barring child welfare providers from discriminating against LGBTQ+ kids.
ca_gov_primary_katie_porter.quote: In Congress, I championed bills to protect LGBTQ+ youth, including legislation to better protect LGBTQ+ students from bullying and harassment and legislation to ban child welfare program providers from discriminating against LGBTQ+ kids.

ca_gov_primary_katie_porter.stance: In Congress she fought to improve pay and health coverage for federal firefighters.
ca_gov_primary_katie_porter.quote: I fought to improve pay and health coverage for federal firefighters.

ca_gov_primary_katie_porter.stance: She plans to reduce incarceration and violence against people with disabilities, pointing to her Mental Health Justice Act to send trained professionals instead of police to people in crisis.
ca_gov_primary_katie_porter.quote: Fight to reduce incarceration and violence against people with disabilities, like I did in Congress by introducing the Mental Health Justice Act to connect people in crisis with trained care professionals instead of law enforcement.

ca_gov_primary_katie_porter.stance: She would eliminate income taxes for Californians earning less than $100,000.
ca_gov_primary_katie_porter.quote: I will eliminate income taxes for Californians earning less than $100,000, build housing that workers can afford, stop charging tuition at our public universities, and make childcare free for all Californians.

ca_gov_primary_katie_porter.stance: She refuses donations from corporations and lobbyists.
ca_gov_primary_katie_porter.quote: Unlike most other Democrats, I refuse donations from corporations and lobbyists.

ca_gov_primary_katie_porter.stance: She says there is no evidence that allowing government to negotiate drug prices would reduce innovation, and she supports government negotiation of drug prices.
ca_gov_primary_katie_porter.quote: there is simply no set of facts that supports that allowing the government to negotiate drug prices would reduce innovation

ca_gov_primary_raji_rab.stance: Supports women's right to reproductive health care access and privacy, including legal protections for women traveling to California for abortion services.
ca_gov_primary_raji_rab.quote: I support women’s right for reproductive health care access and privacy, legally protecting women who travel from other states to access abortion services here in California, including shielding their medical records.

ca_gov_primary_raji_rab.stance: Believes healthcare is a human right and supports full, free healthcare for every American through Medicare for All.
ca_gov_primary_raji_rab.quote: I believe that healthcare rights are human rights, and every American deserves full and free healthcare with Medicare for All.

ca_gov_primary_raji_rab.stance: Plans to expedite manufacturing of medications in California to reduce costs and dependence on imported drugs.
ca_gov_primary_raji_rab.quote: I will expedite medication to be manufactured here in California to reduce costs, create thousands of high paying jobs, improve the economy, and ensure that we are not dependent on other countries.

ca_gov_primary_raji_rab.stance: Supports increasing state investment to develop and manufacture low-cost biosimilar insulin products.
ca_gov_primary_raji_rab.quote: we must increase the exiting Invested $100.7 million to develop and manufacture low-cost biosimilar insulin products to increase the availability & affordability of insulin in California.

ca_gov_primary_raji_rab.stance: Wants to reform education so students are debt-free, including increasing college savings accounts for vulnerable students.
ca_gov_primary_raji_rab.quote: I will increase the existing invested $1.9 billion to set up college savings accounts of up to $1,500 for every vulnerable student and increase the $170 million in ongoing funds to set up accounts for all struggling students when they enter the 1st grade.

ca_gov_primary_raji_rab.stance: Plans to double existing childcare slots and provide universal pre-K including before- and after-school care for all California kids.
ca_gov_primary_raji_rab.quote: I will double the existing childcare slots, universal pre-K including the before- and after-school for all California kids.

ca_gov_primary_raji_rab.stance: Plans to set high standards for clean air and water, control carbon emissions, and expand renewable energy.
ca_gov_primary_raji_rab.quote: As your Governor I will set the highest standards of clean air, water, environmental protection, controlling carbon emissions and expanding advanced renewable energy.

ca_gov_primary_raji_rab.stance: Supports immigration amnesty with a fee and a path to citizenship for undocumented residents.
ca_gov_primary_raji_rab.quote: I support immigration Amnesty of all good undocumented people here on a fee which will bring billions in revenue and filter out the bad actors.

ca_gov_primary_raji_rab.stance: Supports strict background checks and stronger laws to curb gun violence, including for military-style assault weapons.
ca_gov_primary_raji_rab.quote: Military-style assault weapons should not be accessible without strong background checks.

ca_gov_primary_raji_rab.stance: Does not support the death penalty.
ca_gov_primary_raji_rab.quote: I do not support death penalty.

ca_gov_primary_raji_rab.stance: Plans to investigate housing costs, bring regulatory reforms, and seek federal funding for down payment, mortgage, rent, and utility relief.
ca_gov_primary_raji_rab.quote: I will seek federal funding to ease burdensome complexities and offer real housing plans to ease down payment, mortgage, rent and utilities.

ca_gov_primary_raji_rab.stance: Will stop price gouging and investigate price hikes on housing, gas, groceries, and other goods, and seek to bring prices back to pre-COVID levels.
ca_gov_primary_raji_rab.quote: Upon getting elected, I will stop price gouging, investigate the price hike of all items including buying a home, renting, gas, grocery, home goods etc.

ca_gov_primary_raji_rab.stance: Plans to lower taxes to reduce costs and balance the budget without raising taxes.
ca_gov_primary_raji_rab.quote: My NOW Plan will bring billions in global investments, balance budget with a surplus for you and all departments without raising taxes.

ca_gov_primary_satish_rao.stance: Says California has failed vulnerable students at learning to read and wants funding moved from bureaucratic overhead directly to classroom teachers.
ca_gov_primary_satish_rao.quote: California has failed vulnerable students at the most basic task: learning to read. We must aggressively reallocate funding away from bureaucratic overhead and directly into the pockets of the teachers working with students.

ca_gov_primary_satish_rao.stance: Supports charging tuition at Berkeley and opposes free tuition for its largely wealthy student population.
ca_gov_primary_satish_rao.quote: If anything, tuition could be higher, because currently, it isn’t transferring enough wealth. Simply mandating “free tuition” for the largely wealthy student population at Berkeley would amount to a massive financial handout to people who don’t need it.

ca_gov_primary_satish_rao.stance: Believes the People's Park supportive and student housing could be built substantially cheaper in other areas.
ca_gov_primary_satish_rao.quote: The same housing would be substantially cheaper and perhaps more beneficial for many in other areas.

ca_gov_primary_satish_rao.stance: Believes the state, through Medi-Cal, can negotiate better health care deals than individuals can.
ca_gov_primary_satish_rao.quote: Individuals have no chance against the powerful health industry, whereas the state, through Medi-Cal, can negotiate a better deal.

ca_gov_primary_satish_rao.stance: Criticizes California's regulatory approach as failing to solve problems while creating new ones.
ca_gov_primary_satish_rao.quote: In California, there is a regulation for every problem—and too often it fails to solve it while creating new ones.

ca_gov_primary_satish_rao.stance: Says any potential policy solution should be measured against whether it would be better than simply giving people cash.
ca_gov_primary_satish_rao.quote: This may sound glib, but any potential solution should be measured against whether it would be better than just giving people cash.

ca_gov_primary_satish_rao.stance: Criticizes the State Board of Education for repeatedly advancing approaches that have failed and are expensive.
ca_gov_primary_satish_rao.quote: A specific problem is the State Board of Education, which is occupied by advocates who have failed repeatedly and yet continue to inject failed and expensive approaches into our schools.

ca_gov_primary_satish_rao.stance: Wants to strip ideological fads from teaching methods and mandate evidence-based reading and math instruction statewide.
ca_gov_primary_satish_rao.quote: At the same time, we need to strip away ideological fads from our teaching methods and mandate evidence-based reading and mathematics instruction statewide

ca_gov_primary_scott_p_shields.stance: Says social solutions are best achieved with capitalism and freedoms.
ca_gov_primary_scott_p_shields.quote: Social solutions are best achieved with capitalism and freedoms. Social solutions are always needed but not by way of socialism or communism or religious theocracies or dictatorships, which should all be classified as kingdom-hoods.

ca_gov_primary_scott_p_shields.stance: Advocates for systems that support human rights, personal freedom, and economic independence.
ca_gov_primary_scott_p_shields.quote: It is imperative to recognize and challenge these notions, advocating instead for systems that truly support human rights, personal freedom, and economic independence.

ca_gov_primary_scott_p_shields.stance: States that separation of church and state is the only guard against a religious theocracy ruling in government.
ca_gov_primary_scott_p_shields.quote: Separation Of Church And State Was And Still Is The Only Guard Against A Religious Theocracy From Becoming The Rulers In Government.

ca_gov_primary_scott_p_shields.stance: Says the California crypto coin should be launched.
ca_gov_primary_scott_p_shields.quote: With Your Retiring, It Will Be Hard To Fill That Void So We Have To Launch The California Crypto Coin And We Appreciate All You Have Done.

ca_gov_primary_scott_p_shields.stance: Asks policymakers to steer away from Marxist practices and place the petition on their websites.
ca_gov_primary_scott_p_shields.quote: Ask your policymakers and leaders to (not only) steer away from Marxist practices but place this petition on their website.

ca_gov_primary_tom_steyer.stance: He would fully enforce California's Tenant Protection Act, including its rent increase cap, just cause eviction standards, and relocation assistance.
ca_gov_primary_tom_steyer.quote: I will fully enforce California’s Tenant Protection Act to ensure renters are protected statewide, including its cap on excessive rent increases, just cause eviction standards, and relocation assistance for displaced tenants.

ca_gov_primary_tom_steyer.stance: He would close the offshore "Water's Edge Election" and the commercial property loophole under Prop 13, and assess commercial properties at true market value.
ca_gov_primary_tom_steyer.quote: I will close corporate tax giveaways – specifically the offshore “Water’s Edge Election” and the commercial property loophole under Prop 13 – raising over $20 billion a year in new, sustainable revenue by ensuring commercial properties are assessed at their true market value.

ca_gov_primary_tom_steyer.stance: He supported a proposed one-off wealth tax in California in a January 2026 article.
ca_gov_primary_tom_steyer.quote: In January 2026, he wrote an article supporting the proposed one-off wealth tax in California.

ca_gov_primary_tom_steyer.stance: He would create a Golden State Sovereign Wealth Fund by taxing AI companies and use the money for human-only jobs and care programs.
ca_gov_primary_tom_steyer.quote: I will also create the Golden State Sovereign Wealth Fund by taxing AI companies and use this money to expand jobs that fundamentally only humans can do and earmark funds specifically to scale care programs.

ca_gov_primary_tom_steyer.stance: He would ban social media for children under 16.
ca_gov_primary_tom_steyer.quote: Tom will ban social media for kids under 16, because the link between social media use and the youth mental health crisis is clear.

ca_gov_primary_tom_steyer.stance: He would require data centers to ensure energy prices for families go down rather than up.
ca_gov_primary_tom_steyer.quote: Data centers should never cost California families a cent. Tom will mandate that data centers ensure energy prices for families go down – not up.

ca_gov_primary_tom_steyer.stance: In an April 2026 essay, he called for abolishing ICE and proposed California criminally prosecute ICE agents and leadership.
ca_gov_primary_tom_steyer.quote: In an April 2026 essay on his Substack, paired with a post on X (formerly Twitter), Steyer called for the abolition of U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and proposed that California criminally prosecute ICE agents and leadership, end racial profiling through state legislation, expand California's immigration legal-defence infrastructure, and conduct public education on immigrants' rights.

ca_gov_primary_tom_steyer.stance: He would advance single-payer healthcare and work to lower everyday costs.
ca_gov_primary_tom_steyer.quote: Tom Steyer will fight to lower everyday costs, advance single-payer healthcare, and lead the fight against climate change with urgency and innovation.

ca_gov_primary_tom_steyer.stance: He would support teachers and schools so they can provide the best education possible to students.
ca_gov_primary_tom_steyer.quote: We need to support our teachers and our schools so that they can provide the best education possible to kids.

ca_gov_primary_eric_swalwell.stance: Swalwell made gun control a signature issue in his 2019 presidential campaign, including a mandatory buyback of assault weapons and universal background checks.
ca_gov_primary_eric_swalwell.quote: In 2019, Swalwell made gun control a signature issue of his presidential campaign, including a ban with a mandatory buyback of all firearms deemed assault weapons, and universal background checks.

ca_gov_primary_eric_swalwell.stance: Swalwell voted against a bill that would ban abortions after 20 weeks.
ca_gov_primary_eric_swalwell.quote: During a House vote on June 18, 2013, Swalwell used his mobile phone to record a video of his vote against a bill that would ban abortions after 20 weeks

ca_gov_primary_eric_swalwell.stance: Swalwell said ICE would be more credible without masks and advocated tying ICE's funding to a ban on agents wearing masks while on duty.
ca_gov_primary_eric_swalwell.quote: In 2025, in response to masked ICE agents conducting increasingly violent and high-profile enforcement actions against both immigrants and citizens on behalf of the Trump administration, Swalwell said that ICE would be more credible if they did not wear masks, and advocated for legislation that would tie ICE's funding to a ban on agents wearing masks in the course of their duties.

ca_gov_primary_eric_swalwell.stance: Swalwell has proposed a "mobile Congress" in which members would cast votes remotely while spending more time in their districts.
ca_gov_primary_eric_swalwell.quote: He has proposed the idea of a "mobile Congress", with members casting votes remotely while spending more time in their districts.

ca_gov_primary_eric_swalwell.stance: Swalwell voted against the Merger Filing Fee Modernization Act of 2022, an antitrust package aimed at corporate anti-competitive behavior.
ca_gov_primary_eric_swalwell.quote: In 2022, Swalwell was one of 16 Democrats to vote against the Merger Filing Fee Modernization Act of 2022, an antitrust package that would crack down on corporations for anti-competitive behavior.

ca_gov_primary_eric_swalwell.stance: Swalwell co-sponsored the Israel Anti-Boycott Act, which would let states require contractors to pledge not to boycott Israel or Israeli-occupied territories.
ca_gov_primary_eric_swalwell.quote: In 2017, Swalwell co-sponsored the Israel Anti-Boycott Act, a House bill designed to allow U.S. states to enact laws requiring contractors to sign pledges promising not to boycott any goods from Israel and Israeli-occupied territories or their contracts would be terminated.

ca_gov_primary_eric_swalwell.stance: Swalwell criticized Trump's trade war against China.
ca_gov_primary_eric_swalwell.quote: In 2019, Swalwell criticized Trump's trade war against China.

ca_gov_primary_eric_swalwell.stance: Swalwell condemned the 2019 Turkish offensive in northeastern Syria and called for possibly suspending Turkey's NATO membership.
ca_gov_primary_eric_swalwell.quote: He condemned the 2019 Turkish offensive into northeastern Syria and called for possibly suspending Turkey 's membership in NATO.

ca_gov_primary_eric_swalwell.stance: Swalwell proposed closing the Russian embassy in the United States and expelling Russian students in response to the invasion of Ukraine.
ca_gov_primary_eric_swalwell.quote: In 2022, Swalwell proposed measures such as closing the Russian embassy in the United States and expelling Russian students as part of a broader response to the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

ca_gov_primary_eric_swalwell.stance: Swalwell helped lead the fight against lifting the ban on pocketknives at airport security, a decision that was later reversed.
ca_gov_primary_eric_swalwell.quote: He helped lead the fight against Transportation Security Administration administrator John S. Pistole 's decision to lift the ban on pocketknives at airport security; the decision eventually was reversed.

ca_gov_primary_tony_k_thurmond.stance: Build 2 million affordable housing units using surplus property owned by school districts in each of the 58 counties.
ca_gov_primary_tony_k_thurmond.quote: Build 2 million affordable housing units using the surplus property owned by school districts in each of the 58 counties in our state

ca_gov_primary_tony_k_thurmond.stance: Establish a new tax on billionaires and centimillionaires.
ca_gov_primary_tony_k_thurmond.quote: Establish a new tax on billionaires and centimillionaires

ca_gov_primary_tony_k_thurmond.stance: Establish a single-payer health care system.
ca_gov_primary_tony_k_thurmond.quote: Establish a single-payer health care system

ca_gov_primary_tony_k_thurmond.stance: Levy a tax on companies that operate ICE detention centers.
ca_gov_primary_tony_k_thurmond.quote: Levy a tax on companies that operate ICE detention centers

ca_gov_primary_tony_k_thurmond.stance: Pause California's gas tax to provide relief amid rising costs.
ca_gov_primary_tony_k_thurmond.quote: Pause California’s Gas tax to provide relief in the midst of Trump’s Iran War tax

ca_gov_primary_tony_k_thurmond.stance: Establish a universal childcare program to lower costs for working families.
ca_gov_primary_tony_k_thurmond.quote: Establish a universal childcare program to lower costs for working families

ca_gov_primary_tony_k_thurmond.stance: Lead a 5-year plan to ensure every California student can read by third grade.
ca_gov_primary_tony_k_thurmond.quote: Lead a 5-year plan to ensure every California student can read by third grade

ca_gov_primary_tony_k_thurmond.stance: Implement tough, effective guidelines on artificial intelligence companies to protect California workers and consumers.

ca_gov_primary_daniel_mercuri.quote: Afford parents the ability to have ‘ school choice ’ which in turn puts power back into their hands.

ca_gov_primary_daniel_mercuri.stance: Mercuri would expand Section 8 housing to help banks relinquish vacant property and move homeless people off the street.
ca_gov_primary_daniel_mercuri.quote: I will expand on Section 8 Housing that will help allow banks relinquish vacant property and actually get the homeless off the street were the people will have a better stake in their community.

ca_gov_primary_daniel_mercuri.stance: Mercuri plans to make California energy independent and restrict CEQA.
ca_gov_primary_daniel_mercuri.quote: We’ll become energy independent, restrict CEQA, and provide medical freedom.

ca_gov_primary_daniel_mercuri.stance: Mercuri would create a task force to investigate state representatives who protected criminals over children in sex trafficking cases.
ca_gov_primary_daniel_mercuri.quote: I will create a task force that will lead public investigations, to the fullest extent, that will look into ALL of our state’s representatives in EVERY branch that have turned a blind eye, passed egregious legislation like SB145 and SB384, or protected the criminal instead of the child when it comes to the sex trafficking of children and excusal of pedophiles hiding within our government institutions.

ca_gov_primary_frederic_c_schultz.stance: He would re-legalize all drugs by enforcing people's rights to do as they wish with their bodies.
ca_gov_primary_frederic_c_schultz.quote: WE WILL ALSO NOT ONLY MAKE THEM SAFER BUT MAKE THEIR JOBS INFINITELY SAFER WHEN WE RE-LEGALIZE ALL DRUGS BY ENFORCING OUR HUMAN RIGHTS TO DO TO OUR BODIES AS WE WISH.

ca_gov_primary_frederic_c_schultz.stance: He would enforce bodily autonomy rights, including the right to abortion.
ca_gov_primary_frederic_c_schultz.quote: We’ll enforce bodily autonomy rights, to abortion, assisted suicides and guns.

ca_gov_primary_frederic_c_schultz.stance: He opposes lockdowns and forced vaccinations, favoring optional vaccines and real food instead.
ca_gov_primary_frederic_c_schultz.quote: No lockdowns or forced vaccinations: optional and real food instead!

ca_gov_primary_frederic_c_schultz.stance: He supports a rent freeze, citing rent increases that have outpaced wages.
ca_gov_primary_frederic_c_schultz.quote: RENT FREEZE! RENTS HAVE GONE UP ASTRONOMICALLY IN THE PAST 2 DECADES, FAR OUTPACING WAGES.

ca_gov_primary_frederic_c_schultz.stance: He would tax 5% of wealth over $10,000,000 and income over $1,000,000.
ca_gov_primary_frederic_c_schultz.quote: We’ll tax 5% wealth over $10,000,000 and income over $1,000,000, yielding $1,100,000,000,000 annually, retroactively even.

ca_gov_primary_frederic_c_schultz.stance: He would eliminate sales taxes and income taxes on income under $100,000.
ca_gov_primary_frederic_c_schultz.quote: No sales taxes or income taxes under $100,000!

ca_gov_primary_frederic_c_schultz.stance: He supports investing in clean energy sources, especially thorium nuclear power.
ca_gov_primary_frederic_c_schultz.quote: GO TO CLEAN ENERGY: WE MUST INVEST IN RECHARGEABLE BATTERIES, SOLAR, WIND, WAVE, CLEAN GARBAGE INCINERATION (IF POSSIBLE), ETC., ENERGY, BUT ESPECIALLY THORIUM NUCLEAR POWER.

ca_gov_primary_frederic_c_schultz.stance: He would ban pesticides, factory farms, and "autonomous" vehicles.
ca_gov_primary_frederic_c_schultz.quote: We’ll ban pesticides, factory farms, "autonomous" vehicles.

ca_gov_primary_frederic_c_schultz.stance: He would bring back everyone deported by ICE, except those rightly convicted of serious violence, to California.
ca_gov_primary_frederic_c_schultz.quote: BRING BACK EVERYONE DEPORTED BY ICE (BESIDES THOSE RIGHTLY CONVICTED OF SERIOUS VIOLENCE, NOT A SLAP, FOR INSTANCE, WHICH IS STILL WRONG!) TO CALIFORNIA!!

ca_gov_primary_frederic_c_schultz.stance: He would expand the California State Guard to 2,000,000, with one member per classroom, and pardon innocent people held as slaves.
ca_gov_primary_frederic_c_schultz.quote: We’ll increase California State Guard from 900 to 2,000,000, one per classroom, stopping most murders, including by ICE nationwide, preventing martial law, closing slavery/death camps, pardoning innocent slaves!

ca_gov_primary_frederic_c_schultz.stance: He supports ending mass surveillance, including "Flock" spying cameras.
ca_gov_primary_frederic_c_schultz.quote: Privacy rights: No mass surveillance, "Flock" spying cameras.

ca_gov_primary_frederic_c_schultz.stance: He would make public schools smaller, with 15 students per class, more recess, and as little homework as possible.
ca_gov_primary_frederic_c_schultz.quote: MAKE EVERY PUBLIC SCHOOL INCREDIBLE, WITH SMALLER CLASSES (15 STUDENTS/CLASS) AND RECESS, AND AS LITTLE HOMEWORK AS POSSIBLE, PREFERABLY NONE.

ca_gov_primary_margaret_trowe.stance: Calls for a union-backed fight for amnesty for undocumented workers to build working-class unity.
ca_gov_primary_margaret_trowe.quote: Calls for union-backed fight for amnesty for undocumented workers to build working-class unity.

ca_gov_primary_margaret_trowe.stance: Describes herself as a longtime fighter against racism and for women's rights.
ca_gov_primary_margaret_trowe.quote: Longtime fighter against racism, for women's rights and against Washington's wars, from Vietnam to Venezuela.

ca_gov_primary_margaret_trowe.stance: Opposes Washington's wars, from Vietnam to Venezuela.
ca_gov_primary_margaret_trowe.quote: Longtime fighter against racism, for women's rights and against Washington's wars, from Vietnam to Venezuela.

ca_gov_primary_margaret_trowe.stance: Defends Israel's right to exist and to defend itself.
ca_gov_primary_margaret_trowe.quote: Defends Israel's right to exist and defend itself.

ca_gov_primary_margaret_trowe.stance: Supports ending the U.S. economic blockade of Cuba.
ca_gov_primary_margaret_trowe.quote: U.S. Hands off Cuba! End U.S. Economic Blockade of Cuba!

ca_gov_primary_margaret_trowe.stance: Defends free speech, due process, and other Constitutional protections.
ca_gov_primary_margaret_trowe.quote: Defends free speech, due process, other Constitutional protections.

ca_gov_primary_margaret_trowe.stance: Campaigns for workers to take political power as the solution to capitalist crisis and to stop the march to World War III.
ca_gov_primary_margaret_trowe.quote: Campaigns for need for workers to take political power—the only solution to world capitalist economic, political, and moral crisis and the only way to stop the capitalist rulers' march to World War III.

item.as_listed: I will shift resources away from bloat and into community treatment, focusing on recovery instead of a revolving prison door. For too long, we have used our jails as warehouses for the mentally ill while allowing our streets to become encampments.
